name: Restart a systemd unit (Linux)
description: Restarts a named systemd unit and reports its state before and after. Refuses rivet*, systemd-* and dbus* units.

params.name: unit_name
params.label: Unit name
params.description: Name of the systemd unit to restart, for example nginx.service.

params.name: wait_seconds
params.label: Wait seconds
params.description: How long to wait for the unit to become active.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) only reports what would be restarted.

output: [DRY-RUN]/[DONE]/[SKIP] lines with is-active before and after. Exit 0; 2 invalid or refused name; 3 unit missing or restart failed.
